metadata.title: Coach Career IA — your private career agent
metadata.description: Your private career agent: your proof, your guard-rails, and only the opportunities that respect them. Anonymous by default.

footer.privacy: Your data stays yours: never sold, never shared without your consent.

landing.title: Stop job hunting. Let the right opportunities come to you.
landing.intro: Coach Career IA flips the job search around: you build a career memory grounded in proof, you set your conditions, and our agent brings you only the offers that respect them. Without exposing your identity.

anonymous.title: Anonymous by default
anonymous.text: Your identity, contact details and current employer are stored separately, encrypted. Recruiters only see an anonymised profile built on what you can do.

proofs.title: Proof, not promises
proofs.text: Your career memory gathers concrete achievements: projects delivered, measured results, demonstrated skills. They speak for you.

guardRails.title: Your guard-rails do the sorting
guardRails.text: Minimum salary, remote work, excluded sectors, commute time: you set non-negotiable rules. An offer that breaks one never reaches you.

control.title: You stay in control
control.text: Nothing goes out without your consent. When an opportunity interests you, you lift your anonymity in one click — and only for that recruiter.

steps.one: You describe your background with verifiable proof.
steps.two: You set your guard-rails, once and for all.
steps.three: The agent analyses the market and shows you only qualified offers.
steps.four: You decide, offer by offer, whether to reveal yourself.

landing.closingTitle: Your career, your rules, your pace.
landing.closingText: Passwordless sign-in, via a link sent to your email address. No data is shared without your explicit consent.

identity.title: My identity
identity.intro: Your real identity, encrypted in your browser. It is kept apart from your professional profile, which is anonymised.

explain.title: No one, not even us, can read this data
explain.encrypted: Your name, contact details, employers, schools, links and original CV are encrypted in your browser before anything is sent. Our servers only receive and store an unreadable blob.
explain.nobody: Neither our team, nor our host, nor someone who stole our database can decrypt them: the key only exists on your side.
explain.you: Only you unlock them, with your passphrase. It is never sent to or stored by our services.
explain.handover: Your identity is only revealed to a recruiter if you decide so, for that specific recruiter.
explain.loss: if you lose both your passphrase and your recovery key, this data is lost for good. We will not be able to recover it for you. Your professional profile is not affected.

setup.title: Create my identity vault
setup.intro: Choose a passphrase dedicated to this vault, different from your other passwords. A sequence of several words is easy to remember and hard to guess.
setup.understand: I understand that if I lose my passphrase and my recovery key, no one will be able to recover my identity.

recovery.title: Your recovery key
recovery.intro: It lets you reopen your vault if you forget your passphrase. It will never be shown again.
recovery.warning: Keep it offline: printed, in a password manager or in a file stored somewhere safe. Never share it.
recovery.confirm: I have stored my recovery key somewhere safe.

unlock.title: Unlock my identity
unlock.intro: Your vault is locked. Enter your passphrase: decryption happens in this browser.

recover.title: Recover with my recovery key
recover.intro: Enter the recovery key you got when creating the vault, then choose a new passphrase.
recover.recoveryKeyHint: Dashes, spaces and capital letters are optional.

form.title: My identity details
form.intro: Encrypted in your browser when saved. They are never used for matching.
form.contactIntro: Only shared with the recruiter you choose to reveal your identity to.
form.employersIntro: The real name of each employer, linked to the matching experience in your career memory. It shows there when your vault is unlocked.
form.linksIntro: LinkedIn profile, personal website, code repository… any link that identifies you.
form.saveHint: Only the encrypted version leaves your browser.

cv.title: Original CV
cv.intro: Your full CV, with your name and contact details. It is encrypted in your browser before upload: we see neither its content nor its file name.
cv.hint: PDF, Word or OpenDocument, {max} MB maximum.

change.title: Change my passphrase
change.intro: Your data does not need to be re-encrypted. Your recovery key stays valid.

reset.title: Reset the vault
reset.intro: Permanently deletes your encrypted identity and original CV. Useful if you lost both your passphrase and recovery key: you can then create a new vault. Your career memory is not affected.
reset.confirm: Permanently delete your identity vault and CV? This cannot be undone.

coach.intro: A career coach powered by artificial intelligence: it gets to know you, helps you prove your achievements, clarify what you want and prepare your interviews. It never changes your Career Memory without your approval.

start.title: New conversation
start.intro: Choose what you want to work on with the coach.

DISCOVER.title: Discover my profile
DISCOVER.description: A guided interview (situation, task, action, measurable result, proof) to turn your experience into proven achievements.
DISCOVER.welcome: Hello! I’m the Coach Career IA coach, an artificial intelligence. Tell me about a project or assignment you are proud of: we will turn it into a proven achievement, step by step. I will never ask for your employers’ names or your contact details.

CLARIFY.title: Clarify what I want
CLARIFY.description: Salary, location, remote work, contracts, sectors: the coach helps you set clear guard-rails.
CLARIFY.welcome: Hello! I’m the Coach Career IA coach, an artificial intelligence. Let’s pin down what you really want: pay, location, remote work, contract type, sectors to avoid. I will suggest guard-rails that you approve one by one.

INTERVIEW.title: Prepare an interview
INTERVIEW.description: A mock interview for the role you are targeting, with concrete feedback after each answer.
INTERVIEW.welcome: Hello! I’m the Coach Career IA coach, an artificial intelligence. Describe the role you are targeting (title, level, type of company, without naming it) and I will run a practice interview with feedback after each answer.

privacy.title: What happens to your data
privacy.files: Your files are read in memory, then discarded: they are never stored on our servers.
privacy.contacts: Your contact details (email, phone, profile links) are removed before our AI provider analyses the text.
privacy.identity: Names (yours, your employers’ and your schools’) are kept apart: they never enter your profile.
privacy.review: Nothing is added to your memory without your explicit approval.
